name: idyora
description: Indian recipes and calorie data from IDYORA: search dishes, read nutrition per 100 g and per serving, and get full recipes.

interface.longDescription: Look up calories, protein, carbs, fat and fibre for Indian dishes such as aloo ka paratha, dal makhani or besan cheela, per 100 g and per typical serving. Search IDYORA's recipes by meal, diet or goal and read the full recipe with ingredients, method and nutrition per serving. Every number comes from IDYORA's published pages and links back to its source page. IDYORA gives general food information; it does not give medical advice, and it does not access any account or personal data.
capabilities: Look up calories in Indian dishes
defaultPrompt: How many calories are in aloo ka paratha?
Find a high-protein vegetarian Indian lunch recipe.
Show me the palak paneer recipe with its nutrition.

positive.prompt: How many calories are in aloo ka paratha?
positive.expected_behavior: States the calories and protein per 100 g and per serving exactly as returned, names the Indian Nutrient Databank as the source, and links https://idyora.com/calories/aloo-ka-paratha.

positive.prompt: Which has more protein per 100 g, dal makhani or butter chicken?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the protein per 100 g for both dishes from the tool results and says which is higher, with links to both pages.

positive.prompt: Find a high-protein vegetarian Indian lunch recipe.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching IDYORA recipes with calories and protein per serving and a link to each recipe page.

positive.prompt: Show me the palak paneer recipe with its nutrition.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Palak Paneer ingredients and method with nutrition per serving and a link to https://idyora.com/recipes/palak-paneer.

positive.prompt: How many calories are in a California sushi roll according to IDYORA?
positive.expected_behavior: Says IDYORA has no calorie page for that dish and does not invent a number.
